verses.text: Of David. Praise the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands for war and my fingers for battle.
He is my faithful love and my fortress, my high tower and my rescuer, my shield where I find safety. He brings people under my rule.
LORD, what are human beings that you care about them? What is a mere person that you think about them?
People are like a breath. Their days are like a passing shadow.
Open your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains so they smoke.
Send lightning and scatter the enemy. Shoot your arrows and make them run.
Reach down your hand from above. Rescue me and save me from the deep waters, from the power of foreigners,
whose mouths tell lies and whose right hands make false promises.
God, I will sing a new song to you. I will make music to you on the ten-stringed lyre.
You are the one who gives victory to kings, who rescues your servant David from the deadly sword.
Rescue me and save me from the power of foreigners, whose mouths tell lies and whose right hands make false promises.
Then our sons will grow up like healthy young plants, and our daughters will be like beautifully carved pillars in a palace.
Our barns will be full of every kind of food. Our sheep will increase by thousands, even tens of thousands, in our fields.
Our oxen will pull heavy loads. No enemy will break through our walls. No one will be taken captive, and there will be no cries of distress in our streets.
Happy are the people who have these blessings. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.
